note: The baseline generation is the 3be770d5 steady-state harness built from this tree: its gf2 arm is the canonical decoder and its AFF3CT arm the pinned external comparator. The candidate generation is this issue's arms workspace, whose QC arm runs the intra-frame prototype through the same steady-state operation. Both generations are built from one tree with one set of flags, so a pair is a valid A/B.

gf2-nms-f32.description: gf2-coding LdpcDecoder over the canonical EdgeLayout and the shared minimum, second-minimum and sign reduction, f32 flooding normalized min-sum, syndrome stopping, one reused decoder per pinned worker

qc-intra-frame-nms-f32.description: QC-aware intra-frame prototype: the same f32 flooding normalized min-sum contract vectorized across the lifted positions of one frame's circulant blocks, syndrome stopping, one reused decoder per pinned worker
